title: Adventurous American Scallions Fried Rice
description: A flavorful and crispy fried rice dish loaded with sautéed scallions, onions, and juicy bell peppers, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is adaptable to your taste preferences.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the scallions and onions and sauté until they are translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and sauté for another 3 minutes, until they are tender.
Add the garlic and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked rice and stir-fry for 5 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), salt, and black pepper, and stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional scallions and cilantro if desired.
